title: The Bell Ringer
description: A dark spectral cowboy figure wearing a dripping black hat with a golden crown stands in the center, ringing a large bell that emits swirling energy. At his feet on a glowing cyan grid lies a white bovine skull surrounded by broken bells, barbed wire, and shattered fragments against a cracked, stormy background.
prompt: A towering spectral cowboy in a dripping black hat topped with a golden crown, face obscured in shadow, rings an old metal bell that creates swirling vortex energy. He stands on a glowing cyan grid floor scattered with broken bells, barbed wire, and a large white bovine skull in the foreground. Cracked stormy dark background with golden fracture lines, dramatic lighting, surreal and ominous atmosphere.
